title: Fix the Sales Page That Loses Buyers
summary: Find the exact line where visitors stop trusting your sales page, fix that one thing first and check the page again before you spend more on traffic.

money_potential.label: Low
money_potential.basis: Assumes the page already gets visitors; value comes from more of them buying, not from new traffic.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: More of the visitors you already have turn into buyers.
You stop paying for traffic that lands on a page with a known leak.
who_its_for: Owners with an offer page that gets visits but few sales.
Consultants and coaches who sell online.

stack.name: The Walk-Away
stack.role: Reads the page as a stranger would and names the line where a buyer would leave, with the smallest fix.
stack.creator: TheReal_BCM

stack.name: Fresh Eyes Product Auditor
stack.role: Walks the site as a first-time customer and ranks the biggest usability fixes.
stack.creator: Evoputa

stack.name: Site Audit
stack.role: Scores the page on speed, content and conversion basics so slow loads or broken parts do not hide the real issue.

steps: Run the page through a stranger-eyes review and note the line it flags.

Change one thing at a time so you know what worked.
